decisions.statement: The port and the data directory and the scorer's image are read from the environment.
A value the environment does not name is answered with a default rather than refused.
A program that will not start is answered as nothing rather than thrown.
The words spawned here are a program's command line rather than a call's own.
ffprobe answers how many frames a clip has and how large those frames are.
An ffprobe ending at anything but zero is answered with the last line ffprobe wrote.

definition: the host a wan call runs on
